## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link task/acceptance criteria if applicable.

## Scope and contracts

List material schema, route, job, helper-protocol, configuration or compatibility changes. State migration/recovery requirements when relevant.

## Verification

List commands actually run, relevant runtime/engine/OS versions and results. Distinguish mocks from real service tests. For documentation-only changes, list link/path/claim checks.

## Remaining limits

State unrun checks, unresolved risks and release qualification still needed. Do not include credentials, private keys or secret-bearing diagnostics. A merged code path does not imply production qualification.
